title: Complex Number Multiplication
description: Multiply two complex numbers represented as strings and return the result as a string.
pseudocode:
1. Parse real and imaginary parts from string
2. Calculate (a+bi)*(c+di) = (ac-bd) + (ad+bc)i
3. Format result as string

steps.note: Parse inputs: '1+1i' and '1+1i' to components [a=1, b=1] and [c=1, d=1]
